content_metadata.description: This video provides a tutorial on how to speed up a Windows 10 computer with step-by-step instructions and visual demonstrations.

qAndA.answer: The first step is to change the power option to High Performance.
qAndA.question: What is the first step to take to speed up the computer?

qAndA.answer: The name of the second menu is Task Manager.
qAndA.question: What is the name of the second menu used in the tutorial?

qAndA.answer: Defragmenting the computer is a necessary step because it helps the computer run more efficiently.
qAndA.question: Why is it necessary to defragment the computer?

qAndA.answer: You have to click on optimize.
qAndA.question: What should you do after scanning the drives to optimize?

qAndA.answer: The last step is to change the "Menushowdelay" and "MouseHoverTime" data values to "10" in the Registry Editor.
qAndA.question: What is the last step in the tutorial?

videoEditingDetails.description: The video begins with a yellow background with a white banner and a pink ball bouncing under it. "COMPUTER TUTORIAL" appears written in the banner. Then, the text "How to Speed Up" appears in pink and "Windows 10 Performance" in blue.

activities.description: The narrator begins the tutorial by explaining that he will show how to speed up a Windows 10 computer.
The narrator shows how to change the Power Option in Windows 10 to speed it up.
The narrator shows how to change the Startup apps in the Task Manager to speed up Windows 10.
The narrator shows how to defragment Windows 10 to make the computer run faster.
The narrator shows how to clean the disk space to speed up Windows 10.
The narrator shows how to adjust the visual effects in Windows 10 to improve computer performance.
The narrator shows how to delete the Temporary Files from the computer.
The narrator shows how to hide Windows Services in Windows 10.
The narrator shows how to make changes in the Registry Editor to speed up the PC.

The text "01 Power Option" appears in the speech bubble and the arrow.
